40002668.author: पदार्थः
40002668.content: महाराजः maharaja कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, दारुणम् dreadful, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ततः thereafter, चिन्ताम् grief, अभिसमापेदे got, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, प्रतताप च was extremely distressed.

40002668.author: Translation
40002668.content: After hearing the dreadful words of Kaikeyi, the maharaja (Dasaratha), engulfed in grief, was extremely distressed for a moment.

40002669.author: पदार्थः
40002669.content: मे my, स्वप्नः किं नु is this a dream?, यदि वा or, मम my, चित्तमोहोऽपि वा or hallucination of the mind?, अनुभूतोपसर्गो वा or some  foreboding of evil I am going to experience , मनसः mind's, उपद्रवः वा or a malady.

40002669.author: Translation
40002669.content: ' Is this a dream? Or a hallucination of the mind? Or some foreboding evil I am going to experience or a malady of my mind'? (wondered Dasaratha)

40002670.author: पदार्थः
40002670.content: राजा king, इति thus, तत् about that , सञ्चित्य having thought over, तदा then, सुखम् comfort, नाध्यगच्छत् did not get, कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः  struck by the words of Kaikeyi, नराधिपः king, चिरात् after a long time, संज्ञाम् senses, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, व्याघ्रीम् a  tigress, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मृगः यथा like a deer, व्यथितः distressed, विक्लबः च एव startled, असंवृतायाम् uncovered, जगत्याम् on the ground, आसीनः having sat down, मण्डले in a circle, मन्त्रै: by  incantations, रुद्धः confined, महाविषः highly venomous, पन्नगः इव like a serpent, दीर्घम् intense, उच्छवसन् heaving, सामर्षः with indignation, आहो धिक् what a pity, इति thus, वाचम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, शोकोपहतचेतनः with his senses struck by sorrow, भूयः again, मोहम् loss of consciousness, आपेदिवान् obtained.

40002670.author: Translation
40002670.content: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled  and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare floor heaving deep sighs like  a venomous serpent lying confined in a circle. 'What a pity' said the king with indignation and with his senses overwhelmed  by sorrow  fell into a stupor again.

40002673.author: पदार्थः
40002673.content: नृपः  the king, चिरेण after a long time, संज्ञाम् consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, सुदुःखितः  distressed, क्रुद्धः angry, चक्षुषा with eyes, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, प्रदहन्निव as if burning, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40002673.author: Translation
40002673.content: Regaining his consciousness after a long time, the king in deep grief and with eyes as though burning in anger looked at  Kaikeyi  and said:

40002674.author: पदार्थः
40002674.content: नृशंसे O cruel woman, दुष्टचारित्रे  of wicked character, अस्य कुलस्य of this family, विनाशिनि destroyer, पापे sinful woman, रामेण by Rama, मयापि वा or by me, तव your, किं पापं कृतम् what harm has been done?

40002674.author: Translation
40002674.content: O woman of cruel and sinful nature, you are bent on destroying this family. What harm has been done to you  by Rama or by me?

40002675.author: पदार्थः
40002675.content: राघवः Rama, यदा when  ते in relation to you, जननीतुल्याम् like his own mother, वृत्तिम् conduct, वहति was carrying out, तस्यैव to such a person, अनर्थाय for injustice, त्वम् you, किं निमित्तम् for what purpose, इह here, उद्यता are you attempting?

40002675.author: Translation
40002675.content: Then Rama was conducting himself in relation to you as his own mother, for what purpose are you seeking injustice to such a person?

40002676.author: पदार्थः
40002676.content: त्वम् you, नृपसुता king's daughter, मया by me, तीक्ष्णविषा  venomous, व्याली यथा like a female serpent, अविज्ञानात् by ignorance, स्वं भवनम् my home, आत्म विनाशार्थम् for  selfdestruction, प्रवेशिता  ushered in.

40002676.author: Translation
40002676.content: In my ignorance I brought home for my selfdestruction a king's daughter who was like a venomous female serpent.

40002677.author: पदार्थः
40002677.content: यदा when, सर्वः all, जीवलोकः living beings of the world, रामस्य Rama's, गुणस्तवम् extoling  virtues, आह is telling, (then), कम् what, अपराधम् crime, उद्धिश्य showing, अहम् I, इष्टं सुतम् beloved son, त्यक्ष्यामि I shall abandon.

40002677.author: Translation
40002677.content: When all living beings of this world are extoling the virtues of Rama, for what crime should I abandon my beloved son?

40002678.author: पदार्थः
40002678.content: कौशल्यां वा even Kausalya, सुमित्रां वा or even Sumitra, श्रियमपि वा wealth, आत्मनः my own , जीवितं वा life also, त्यजेयम् shall give up, पितृवत्सलम् who is devoted to  his father, रामं तु Rama, न will not leave.

40002678.author: Translation
40002678.content: I shall give up Kausalya or Sumitra or all my wealth or even my own life but I cannot leave Rama who is devoted to his father.

40002679.author: पदार्थः
40002679.content: अग्रजम् firstborn, तनयम् son, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मे my, परा supreme, प्रीतिः भवति will be my delight, रामम् Rama, अपश्यतस्तु but if I do not see him, मे my, चेतना life, नष्टा भवति is destroyed.

40002679.author: Translation
40002679.content: When I see my firstborn , I experience supreme delight. But if I do not see him, my life loses its meaning.

40002680.author: पदार्थः
40002680.content: लोकः world, सूर्यं विना without the Sun, तिष्ठेत् can exist, सस्यम् crops, सलिलं विना वा without water, तु but, रामं विना without Rama, मम देहे my body, जीवितम् life, न तिष्ठेत् shall not exist.

40002680.author: Translation
40002680.content: This world can exist without the Sun or crops (can be grown) without water but without Rama, life would not exist in my body.

40002681.author: पदार्थः
40002681.content: पापनिश्चये O lady of evil intentions, तत् for that reason, अलम् enough, एषः such, निश्चयः intention, त्यज्यताम्  give up, एषः here I, ते चरणौ your feet, मूर्ध्ना with my head, स्पृशाम्यपि will touch, मे my (to me), प्रसीद you may be pleased.

40002681.author: Translation
40002681.content: O lady of evil intentions, enough of this. Give up your resolve. Here I touch your feet with my head. Be pleased with me.

40002682.author: पदार्थः
40002682.content: पापे O sinful one, त्वया by you, परमदारुणम्  most  dreadful, इदम् this, किम् why, चिन्तितम् thought, अथ or, त्वम् you, माम् me, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियाप्रिये about likes or dislikes, जिज्ञाससे enquire, अस्तु let it be so, त्वया by you, राघवं प्रति speaking of Rama, श्रीमान् noble, सः that Rama, मे my, धर्मज्येष्ठः foremost in  discharging his duties, सुतः son, इतीव like this, पूर्वम् earlier, तत् that , यत् what words, व्याहृतम् uttered, तत् those, प्रियवादिन्या by a woman speaking sweet words, त्वया by you, सेवार्थम् only to serve(please) me, कथितं भवेत् could have been said.

40002682.author: Translation
40002682.content: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know  my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his  duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.

40002683.author: पदार्थः
40002683.content: पापे O sinful one, त्वया by you, परमदारुणम्  most  dreadful, इदम् this, किम् why, चिन्तितम् thought, अथ or, त्वम् you, माम् me, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियाप्रिये about likes or dislikes, जिज्ञाससे enquire, अस्तु let it be so, त्वया by you, राघवं प्रति speaking of Rama, श्रीमान् noble, सः that Rama, मे my, धर्मज्येष्ठः foremost in  discharging his duties, सुतः son, इतीव like this, पूर्वम् earlier, तत् that , यत् what words, व्याहृतम् uttered, तत् those, प्रियवादिन्या by a woman speaking sweet words, त्वया by you, सेवार्थम् only to serve(please) me, कथितं भवेत् could have been said.

40002684.content: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know  my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his  duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.

40002685.author: पदार्थः
40002685.content: तत् further, सा त्वम् you are such, परवशंगता under the influence of others, श्रुत्वा  hearing their words, शोकसन्तप्ता tormented with sorrow, शून्यं गृहम् empty chamber of wrath, आविष्टा असि you have entered, माम् me, भृशम् greatly, सन्तापयसि causing me great pain.

40002685.author: Translation
40002685.content: Further you are tormented with sorrow under the influence of others' insinuations. You are causing me great pain by entering the empty chamber of wrath.

40002686.author: पदार्थः
40002686.content: नयसम्पन्ने endowed with a moral sense, देवि O queen, यत्र wherever, ते your, मतिः mind, विकृता changed, इक्ष्वाकुणां कुले in the  Ikshvaku race, सुमहान् very great, अयम् this, अनयः immorality, सम्प्राप्तः has befallen.

40002686.author: Translation
40002686.content: O queen, till now you had a moral sense. With your mind debased (now), a very great immorality has infected the  Ikshvaku race.

40002687.author: पदार्थः
40002687.content: विशालाक्षि O largeeyed lady, पुरा in the past, मम to me, किञ्चित् even little, अयुक्तं वा improper, विप्रियं वा or unpalatable, त्वम् you, न अकरोः did not render, तेन for that reason, अहम् I  न श्रद्दधामि do not believe.

40002687.author: Translation
40002687.content: O largeeyed lady, you have never done anything improper or unpalatable towards me in the past. Therefore I do not  believe your words.

40002688.author: पदार्थः
40002688.content: ते to you, राघवः Raghava, महात्मना highsouled, भरतेन with Bharata, तुल्यः ननु is equal indeed, सुबाले O childish one, त्वम् you, बहुशः several times, मम to me, कथाः कथयसे (मम) हि used to tell (me).

40002688.author: Translation
40002688.content: O childish one, you used to tell me several times that Rama is as dear to you as the highsouled Bharata.

40002689.author: पदार्थः
40002689.content: भीरु O lady, देवि O queen, धर्मात्मनः of that righteous one, यशस्विनः illustrious, तस्य his, नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि fourteen years, वनवासम् to dwell in the forest, कथम् how, रोचयसे  wish?

40002689.author: Translation
40002689.content: O lady how do you wish this righteous and illustrious Rama to dwell in the forest for fourteen years?

40002690.author: पदार्थः
40002690.content: अत्यन्तसुकुमारस्य exceedingly tender one, धर्मे in virtues, धृतात्मनः firmminded one, तस्य his  (Rama's), भृशदारुणे very dreadful, अरण्ये in the forest, वासम् to dwell, कथम् why, रोचयसे  you like?

40002690.author: Translation
40002690.content: Why do you want Rama who is so tender and a firm follower of dharma to dwell in the highly dreadful forest?

40002691.author: पदार्थः
40002691.content: शुभलोचने O woman of beautiful eyes, तव to you, शुश्रूषमाणस्य desirous of serving,    अभिरामस्य charming, रामस्य Rama's, विप्रवासनम् exile to a distant place, किमर्थम् why,   रोचयसि do you desire?

40002691.author: Translation
40002691.content: O woman with attractive eyes, why do you want Rama who is so charming and serving you to be exiled to a distant place?

40002692.author: पदार्थः
40002692.content: रामः Rama, भरतात् more than Bharata, भूयः still more, सदा always, तव to you, शुश्रूषते is doing service, तस्मात्तु for that reason also, त्वयि in you, भरतस्य Bharata's, विशेषम् speciality, न लक्षये I do not see.

40002692.author: Translation
40002692.content: Rama is doing greater service to you than Bharata. Therefore, I do not find any reason for you to have a special love for Bharata.

40002693.author: पदार्थः
40002693.content: बहूनाम् many, स्त्रीसहस्राणाम् thousands of women, बहूनाम् many, उपजीविनाम् attendants, अन्यत्र मनुजर्षभात् other than Rama who is the best among men, कः who, ते to you, भूयस्तरम् great, शुश्रूषाम् service, गौरवम् honour, प्रमाणं चैव trusting your words as true, वचनक्रियाम् carrying out your orders, कुर्यात् will do?

40002693.author: Translation
40002693.content: There are many thousands of women and attendants (in the inner apartment), but who will do greater service and honour you more than Rama, the best among men in the execution of your orders.

40002694.author: पदार्थः
40002694.content: राघवे in the matter of Rama, परिवादः word of blame, अपवादो वा or word of reproach, नोपपद्यते does not aply to him, मनुजव्याघ्रः a tiger among men, रामः Rama, शुद्धेन with pure, चेतसा heart, सर्वभूतानि all beings, सान्त्वयन् while appeasing, विषयवासिनः inhabitants of the country, प्रियैः by doing acts dear to them, गृह्णाति attracts them.

40002694.author: Translation
40002694.content: The best among men, Rama has won the trust of the inhabitants of the country by securing their affection with a pure heart and by doing acts dear to them. Therefore, neither a word of blame nor reproach applies to this scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama).

40002695.author: पदार्थः
40002695.content: राघवे in the matter of Rama, परिवादः word of blame, अपवादो वा or word of reproach, नोपपद्यते does not aply to him, मनुजव्याघ्रः a tiger among men, रामः Rama, शुद्धेन with pure, चेतसा heart, सर्वभूतानि all beings, सान्त्वयन् while appeasing, विषयवासिनः inhabitants of the country, प्रियैः by doing acts dear to them, गृह्णाति attracts them.

40002695.author: Translation
40002695.content: The best among men, Rama has won the trust of the inhabitants of the country by securing their affection with a pure heart and by doing acts dear to them. Therefore, neither a word of blame nor reproach applies to this scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama).

40002696.author: पदार्थः
40002696.content: वीरः hero, राघवः Rama, सत्येन by truth, लोकान् the people, दानेन by charity, दीनान् the poor, जयति wins over, शुश्रूषया by his service, गुरून् his preceptors, युधि in battle, धनुषा by the power of his bow, शात्रवान् enemies, जयति conquers.

40002696.author: Translation
40002696.content: Rama is a hero who wins over the people by his truthfulness, the poor by charity, the preceptors by his service and the enemies in the battle by the power of  his bow.

40002697.author: पदार्थः
40002697.content: सत्यम् truth, दानम् munificence, तपः asceticism, त्यागः renunciation, शौचम् purity, आर्जवम् uprightness, विद्या च also learning, गुरुशुश्रूषा service to his superiors, एतानि all these, राघवे in Rama, ध्रुवाणि are firmly fixed.

40002697.author: Translation
40002697.content: Truth, munificence, asceticism, renunciation, purity, uprightness, learning and service to his superiors all those (virtues) are firmly planted in this descendant of the Raghus.

40002698.author: पदार्थः
40002698.content: देवि O Devi आर्जवसम्पन्ने one endowed with uprightness, देवोपमे resembling gods, महर्षिसमतेजसि equal to great ascetics in lustre, तस्मिन् रामे in that Rama, कथम् how, पापम् harm, आशंससे wish.

40002698.author: Translation
40002698.content: How do you, O Devi, wish to harm Rama who is endowed with uprightness, who resembles the gods and in lustre to great ascetics?

40002699.author: पदार्थः
40002699.content: लोकस्य in this world, प्रियवादिनः one who speaks pleasing words, अप्रियम् unpleasant, वाक्यम् words, न स्मरामि I do not recollect, सः such a person, प्रियम् beloved, रामम् to Rama, त्वत्कृते for your sake, अप्रियम् unpleasant, कथम् how, वक्ष्यामि can I tell?

40002699.author: Translation
40002699.content: How can I, for your sake, speak harsh to my beloved Rama who uses pleasing words to the people of the world, and never an unpleasant word which I can recall?

40002700.author: पदार्थः
40002700.content: यस्मिन् in whom, क्षमा forgiveness, दमः forbearance, त्यागः renunciation, सत्यम् truthfulness, धर्मः righteousness, कृतज्ञता gratefulness, अपि च and also, भूतानाम् for all living beings, अहिंसा nonviolence, तम् ऋते without him (Rama), मम to me, का गतिः where is the refuge?

40002700.author: Translation
40002700.content: Where is the refuge for me without him in whom dwell forgiveness, forbearance, renunciation, truthfulness, righteousness, gratefulness and also nonviolence towards all living beings?

40002701.author: पदार्थः
40002701.content: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, वृद्धस्य of the aged, गतान्तस्य on the verge of death, तपस्विनः wretched, दीनम् pitifully, लालप्यमानस्य wailing, मम to me, कारुण्यम् mercy, कर्तुम् to show, अर्हसि behoves you.

40002701.author: Translation
40002701.content: O Kaikeyi, you should show mercy to this wretched, old man on the verge of death, wailing pitifully.

40002702.author: पदार्थः
40002702.content: सागरान्तायम् bounded by  ocean, पृथिव्याम्  on this earth, यत्किञ्चित् whatever, अधिगम्यते can be secured, तत् सर्वम् all that, तव to you, दास्यामि shall give त्वाम् you, मन्युः anger, मा आविशेत्  do not possess.

40002702.author: Translation
40002702.content: I shall give you all that can be secured on this earth bounded by the ocean. Show no anger.

40002703.author: पदार्थः
40002703.content: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, अञ्जलिं करोमि I bow to you with folded palms, ते your, पादौ feet, स्पृशामि चापि I touch too, रामस्य for Rama, शरणम् भव be the saviour, माम् me, अधर्मः sin, इह in this matter, मा स्पृशेत् may not touch.

40002703.author: Translation
40002703.content: O Kaikeyi I bow to you with folded palms. I touch your feet, too. Be the saviour of Rama. Let no sin taint me here (in this life).

40002704.author: पदार्थः
40002704.content: अथ after that, रौद्रा cruelnatured, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, इति in this way, दुःखाभिसन्तप्तम् tormented with grief, विलपन्तम् lamenting, अचेतनम् unconscions, घूर्णमानम् (head) reeling, शोकेन with pain, समभिप्लुतम् overwhelmed, पुनः पुनः again and again, शोकार्णवस्य of the ocean of sorrow, पारम् to the other side, आशु quickly, प्रार्थयन्तम् beseeching, राजानम् to the king, रौद्रतरम् more fierce, वचः words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40002704.author: Translation
40002704.content: Then the fierce Kaikeyi used fiercer words in reply to the king who was tormented with grief and filled with tears, senses switched off, head reeling, overwhelmed with pain, beseeching again and again to ferry him across the ocean of sorrow as quickly as possible:

40002705.author: पदार्थः
40002705.content: अथ after that, रौद्रा cruelnatured, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, इति in this way, दुःखाभिसन्तप्तम् tormented with grief, विलपन्तम् lamenting, अचेतनम् unconscions, घूर्णमानम् (head) reeling, शोकेन with pain, समभिप्लुतम् overwhelmed, पुनः पुनः again and again, शोकार्णवस्य of the ocean of sorrow, पारम् to the other side, आशु quickly, प्रार्थयन्तम् beseeching, राजानम् to the king, रौद्रतरम् more fierce, वचः words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40002705.author: Translation
40002705.content: Then the fierce Kaikeyi used fiercer words in reply to the king who was tormented with grief and filled with tears, senses switched off, head reeling, overwhelmed with pain, beseeching again and again to ferry him across the ocean of sorrow as quickly as possible:

40002706.author: पदार्थः
40002706.content: राजन् O king, वरौ boons, दत्वा having given, प्रत्यनुतप्यसे यदि if you are repenting like this, वीर valiant, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, धार्मिकत्वम् righteousness, कथम् how, कथयिष्यसि will you speak?

40002706.author: Translation
40002706.content: O valiant king, if you repent like this after having given two boons, how will you talk about your righteousness on this earth?

40002707.author: पदार्थः
40002707.content: धर्मज्ञ O knower of righteousness, त्वया by you, समेताः assemble together, बहवः innumerable, राजर्षयः rajarshis, यदा when, कथयिष्यन्ति they speak for, तत्र then, किम् what, प्रतिवक्ष्यसि what will you answer?

40002707.author: Translation
40002707.content: O knower of righteousness when innumerable rajarshis assemble and ask you on this what answer will you give?

40002708.author: पदार्थः
40002708.content: यस्याः of whose, प्रसादे mercy, जीवामि I am alive, या such, माम् me, अभ्यपालयत् protected, तस्याः such, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, मया by me, मिथ्याकृतम् broken the promise, इति like this, वक्ष्यसि will you tell?

40002708.author: Translation
40002708.content: Will you say, 'To such a Kaikeyi by whose mercy I am alive and by whom I was protected, I have broken the promise given'?

40002709.author: पदार्थः
40002709.content: नराधिप O king, यः such you are, अद्यैव right now, वरम् a boon, दत्वा having given, पुनः again, अन्यानि other than those words, भाषसे are speaking, त्वम् you, नरेन्द्राणाम् for kings, किल्बिषत्वम् blemish, करिष्यसि you are bringing.

40002709.author: Translation
40002709.content: O king, right now having given two boons, you are speaking otherwise. You are bringing blemish to kings (of the Ikshwaku race)

40002710.author: पदार्थः
40002710.content: श्येनकपोतीये in the conflict between a hawk and a pigeon, शैब्यः king Saibya, पक्षिणे to the hawk, स्वमांसम् his own flesh, ददौ gave, अलर्कः king Alarka, चक्षुषी eyes, दत्वा having given, उत्तमां गतिम् highest state, जगाम attained.

40002710.author: Translation
40002710.content: (King) Saibya gave his own flesh to the hawk in the conflict between the hawk and the pigeon. (King) Alarka gave his eyes (to a blind man) and attained the highest state.

40002711.author: पदार्थः
40002711.content: सागरः ocean, समयम् vow, कृत्वा having made, वेलाम् the shore, अतिवर्तते does not cross, पूर्ववृत्तम् history of the earlier kings, अनुस्मरन् recollecting, समयम् the vow, अनृतम् false, मा कार्षीः do not make.

40002711.author: Translation
40002711.content: Having made the vow (to the gods), the ocean does not advance beyond the shore. Recollect the history of the earlier kings and do not make the vow false.

40002712.author: पदार्थः
40002712.content: दुर्मते O wickedminded one, सः त्वम् you are such, धर्मम् righteousness, परित्यज्य deserting, रामम् of Rama, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषिच्य च having installed, कौसल्यया सह along with Kausalya, नित्यम् always, रन्तुम् to enjoy, इच्छसि are you desiring.

40002712.author: Translation
40002712.content: O wickedminded one, deserting righteousness and installing Rama in the kingdom, you want to enjoy life with Kausalya everafter?

40002713.author: पदार्थः
40002713.content: अधर्मः unrighteousness, धर्मो वा or righteousness, सत्यं वा or true, यदि वा or, अनृतम् false, भवतु let it be so, त्वया by you, मह्यम् for me, यत् whatever, संश्रुतम् was promised, तस्य for that, व्यतिक्रमः deviation, नास्ति is not there.

40002713.author: Translation
40002713.content: Whether righteous or unrighteous, true or false, there is no deviation from what you have promised to me.

40002714.author: पदार्थः
40002714.content: रामः Rama, अभिषिच्यते यदि if installed (as princeregent), अहम् I, अद्यैव today itself, तव your, अग्रतः presence, बहु excessive, विषम् poison, पीत्वा drinking, ते पश्यतः even as you are watching, मरिष्यामि हि will indeed die.

40002714.author: Translation
40002714.content: If Rama is coronated I will die while as you are watching right in your presence today itself by drinking excessive poison.

40002715.author: पदार्थः
40002715.content: अहम् I, एकाहमपि even for a day, राम मातरम् Rama's mother, अञ्जलिम् homage, प्रति गृह्णन्तीम् receving, पश्येयं यदि if I were to see, मम my, मृतिः death, श्रेयः ननु is preferable to  me.

40002715.author: Translation
40002715.content: If I were to see Rama's mother receiving homage from everybody even for a day, I shall prefer my death.

40002716.author: पदार्थः
40002716.content: मनुजाधिप O chief of men, भरतेन by Bharata, आत्मना च on my own life, ते to you, शपे I swear, यथा that, रामनिवासनात् ऋते except banishment of Rama (to forest), अन्येन by any other (means), न तुष्येयम् I will not be satisfied.

40002716.author: Translation
40002716.content: O king, I swear on Bharata and on my own life that nothing less than Rama's banishment will satisfy me.

40002717.author: पदार्थः
40002717.content: कैकेयी Kaikeyi, एतावत् to this extent, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having spoken, विरराम ह remained silent, विलपन्तम् lamenting, राजानम् to the king, सा she, न प्रतिव्याजहार did not speak in reply.

40002717.author: Translation
40002717.content: Kaikeyi, having spoken to this extent remained silent. She heeded not the lament of the king.

40002718.author: पदार्थः
40002718.content: राजा तु as regards the king, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, वृतम् asked for, परम् very, अशोभनम् inauspicious, रामस्य Rama's, वने वासम् exile to the forest, भरतस्य Bharata's, ऐश्वर्यं च wealth (enthronement), श्रुत्वा having heard, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, व्याकुलेन्द्रिय: with agitated senses, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, नाभ्यभाषत did not speak.

40002718.author: Translation
40002718.content: Having heard of the highly unfair demands by Kaikeyi for Rama's exile to the forest and Bharata's prosperity (enthronement), the king was dumbstruck for a while with his senses agitated. He did not speak to Kaikeyi.

40002719.author: पदार्थः
40002719.content: अप्रियवादिनीम् to one who speaks unpleasant words, प्रियाम् to the beloved, देवीम् to the queen, अनिमिषः unblinking eyes, प्रैक्षत gazed, वज्रसमाम् resembling a thunderbolt, हृदयाप्रियाम् unpleasant to the heart, दुःखशोकमयीम् filled with grief and anguish, घोराम् dreadful, तां वाचम् those words, आकर्ण्य having listened, राजा king, सुखितः happy, न अभूत् did not become.

40002719.author: Translation
40002719.content: The unhappy king intently fixed his gaze at his beloved queen speaking unpleasant words charged with grief and anguish, unpleasant to the heart like the dreadful thunderbolt.

40002720.author: पदार्थः
40002720.content: अप्रियवादिनीम् to one who speaks unpleasant words, प्रियाम् to the beloved, देवीम् to the queen, अनिमिषः unblinking eyes, प्रैक्षत gazed, वज्रसमाम् resembling a thunderbolt, हृदयाप्रियाम् unpleasant to the heart, दुःखशोकमयीम् filled with grief and anguish, घोराम् dreadful, तां वाचम् those words, आकर्ण्य having listened, राजा king, सुखितः happy, न अभूत् did not become.

40002720.author: Translation
40002720.content: The unhappy king intently fixed his gaze at his beloved queen speaking unpleasant words charged with grief and anguish, unpleasant to the heart like the dreadful thunderbolt.

40002721.author: पदार्थः
40002721.content: सः he, देव्याः the queen's, व्यवसायं च determination, कृतम् having made, घोरम् dreadful, शपथं च vow, ध्यात्वा reflecting, निश्श्वस्य sighing, राम इति crying 'Rama', छिन्नः severed, तरुरिव like a tree, अपतत् fell down.

40002721.author: Translation
40002721.content: Reflecting on the determination of the queen and her dreadful vow, the king sighed and cried, 'O Rama' and then fell down like a tree severed.

40002722.author: पदार्थः
40002722.content: जगतीपतिः lord of the earth, नष्टचित्तः the mind deranged, उन्मत्तः यथा like a madman, विपरीतः behaving in a contrary manner, आतुरः यथा like a sick person, हृततेजाः with its taken away (by mantra), सर्पः यथा like a serpent, बभूव became.

40002722.author: Translation
40002722.content: The lord of the earth (Dasaratha) became like a man with the mind deranged, like a sick man behaving to the contrary, like a serpent with its energy drained (through mantra).

40002723.author: पदार्थः
40002723.content: राजा king, दीनया humble, गिरा words, कैकयीम् to Kaikeyi, इति thus, उवाच ह spoke, अर्थाभम् appearing beneficial to you, अनर्थम् such calamitous act, केन for what, त्वम् you, उपदर्शिता exhibited?, भूतोपहतचित्तेव faculties possessed by evil spirit, माम् me, ब्रुवन्ती while speaking, न लज्जसे (you) do not feel ashamed.

40002723.author: Translation
40002723.content: The king addressed Kaikeyi in humble words saying, Why did you exhibit this unfortunate act apparently beneficial to you? You are not ashamed of saying this like one whose faculties are possessed by an evil spirit.

40002724.author: पदार्थः
40002724.content: पुरा earlier, बालायाः when you were young, ते your, एतत् this, शीलव्यसनम् perverse behaviour, अहम् I, नाभिजानामि did not know, तु but, इदानीम् now, ते your, तत् about that, लक्षये perceiving, विपरीतवत् reverse of it.

40002724.author: Translation
40002724.content: I never knew earlier when you were young that you possessed such perverse behaviour. But now I perceive the reverse (of what I knew).

40002725.author: पदार्थः
40002725.content: ते to you, कुतः वा from where, भयम् fear, जातम् was born, या you, भरतम् to Bharata, राष्ट्रे in the kingdom, आसीनम् seated, राघवम् to Rama, वने in the forest, एवं विधम् this type of, वरम् a boon, वृणीषे you are asking for.

40002725.author: Translation
40002725.content: You are asking for a boon that Bharata should be enthroned in the kingdom while Rama should live in the forest. From where did you get this apprehension?

40002726.author: पदार्थः
40002726.content: भर्तुः of your husband, लोकस्य of this world, भरतस्य च of Bharata also, प्रियम् beneficence, कार्यं यदि if you wish to do, एतेन भावेन with this thought (that Bharata should become king), अनृतेन with falsehood, एतेन वा or with such thought of exiling Rama, त्वम् you, विरम refrain.

40002726.author: Translation
40002726.content: If you wish to do good to your husband, to the world and also to Bharata, refrain from this illusory thought.

40002727.author: पदार्थः
40002727.content: नृशंसे O cruel one, पापसङ्कल्पे O (woman) of sinful resolve, क्षुद्रे O vile (creature), दुष्कृतकारिणि O woman of evil deeds, मयि in me, रामे च also in Rama, किं नु what, दुःखम् wrong, अलीकं वा or sin, पश्यसि see?

40002727.author: Translation
40002727.content: O cruel one, O woman of sinful resolve, O vile (creature), O woman of evil deeds, what  wrong or sin do you really see in Rama or in me.

40002728.author: पदार्थः
40002728.content: रामादृते depriving Rama, भरतः Bharata, कथञ्चित् by whatever means, राज्यम् kingdom, न आवसेत् will not occupy, हि because, तम् him, रामादपि more than Rama, धर्मतः righteously, बलवत्तरम् stronger, मन्ये I consider.

40002728.author: Translation
40002728.content: Depriving Rama, Bharata in no way will occupy the kingdom because in the matter of righteousness I think he is superior even to Rama.

40002729.author: पदार्थः
40002729.content: वनं गच्छ go to the forest, इति like that, भाषिते on saying, उपप्लुतम् eclipsed, इन्दुं यथा like moon, विवर्णम् pale, रामस्य Rama's, मुखम् face, कथम् how, द्रक्ष्यामि shall I see.

40002729.author: Translation
40002729.content: While instructing Rama to go to the forest, how can I look at his face, pale like the eclipsed moon?

40002730.author: पदार्थः
40002730.content: सुकृताम् well thoughtout, सुहृद्भि: सह in consultation with friends, निश्चिताम् has been decided, मे I, तां बुद्धिम् that decision, परैः by enemies, हताम् defeated, चमूमिव like the  army, अपावृत्ताम् retreating, कथम् how, द्रक्ष्यामि can I see, नानादिग्भ्यः from different directions, समागताः men assembled, राजानः all kings, माम् about me, किम् what, वक्ष्यन्ति they will speak of, बालः ignorant one, अयम् ऐक्ष्वाकः this Dasaratha, चिरम् for a long time, राज्यम् kingdom, अकारयत् ruled.

40002730.author: Translation
40002730.content: I have taken this decision in consultation with friends to install Rama. How can I see such a decision being reversed like a retreating army defeated by enemies? Kings from different quarters have already arrived and they will say, How did this ignorant descendant of the Ikshakus (Dasaratha) rule this kingdom for such a long time?

40002731.author: पदार्थः
40002731.content: सुकृताम् well thoughtout, सुहृद्भि: सह in consultation with friends, निश्चिताम् has been decided, मे I, तां बुद्धिम् that decision, परैः by enemies, हताम् defeated, चमूमिव like the  army, अपावृत्ताम् retreating, कथम् how, द्रक्ष्यामि can I see, नानादिग्भ्यः from different directions, समागताः men assembled, राजानः all kings, माम् about me, किम् what, वक्ष्यन्ति they will speak of, बालः ignorant one, अयम् ऐक्ष्वाकः this Dasaratha, चिरम् for a long time, राज्यम् kingdom, अकारयत् ruled.

40002731.author: Translation
40002731.content: I have taken this decision in consultation with friends to install Rama. How can I see such a decision being reversed like a retreating army defeated by enemies? Kings from different quarters have already arrived and they will say, How did this ignorant descendant of the Ikshakus (Dasaratha) rule this kingdom for such a long time?

40002732.author: पदार्थः
40002732.content: गुणवन्तः virtuous men, बहुश्रुताः welllearned, बहवः वृद्धाः many elders, काकुत्स्थम् about this scion of the Kakutstha race (Rama), यदा when, परिप्रक्ष्यन्ति when they question (me), तदा then, अहम् I, किं वक्ष्यामि what shall I tell (them)?

40002732.author: Translation
40002732.content: When several virtuous and learned elders ask me about Rama, what shall I tell them?

40002733.author: पदार्थः
40002733.content: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, क्लिश्यमानेन by being tortured, मया by me, रामः Rama, वनम् to the  forest, प्रव्राजितः was sent, एतत् this, सत्यम् truth, ब्रवीमि यदि if I tell, तत् that, असत्यम् untruth, भविष्यति will become.

40002733.author: Translation
40002733.content: If I tell the truth 'Tortured by Kaikeyi, I have sent Rama to the forest', none will believe it  and they will consider it untruth.

40002734.author: पदार्थः
40002734.content: राघवे Rama, वनम् to the forest, आस्थिते takes refuge, कौशल्या Kausalya, माम् about me, किं वक्ष्यति what will she say, ईदृशम् such, वि(अ)प्रियम् unpleasant act, कृत्वा च having done, एनाम्  to her, किम् what, प्रतिवक्ष्यामि reply can I give.

40002734.author: Translation
40002734.content: If Rama takes refuge in the forest, what will Kausalya say to me? Having committed such an unpleasant act, what reply can I give her?

40002735.author: पदार्थः
40002735.content: देवि O Kaikeyi, सततम् always, मे प्रियकामा cherishing my welfare, प्रियपुत्रा giving birth to a beloved son, प्रियंवदा sweetspoken, कौशल्या Kausalya, यदा यदा हि whenever, दासीवच्च like an attendant, सखी वच्च like a friend, भार्यावत् like a wife, भगिनी वच्च like a sister, मातृवच्च like a mother, उपतिष्ठति served, सत्कारार्हा fit to receive courteous treatment, तव कृते because of you, मया by me, न सत्कृता never received attention.

40002735.author: Translation
40002735.content: Sweetspoken Kausalya who always cherishes my welfare. who has given me my beloved son, who has served me like an attendant, a friend, a wife, a sister and a mother deserved courteous treatment from me, but  because of you, she never received due attention from me.

40002736.author: पदार्थः
40002736.content: देवि O Kaikeyi, सततम् always, मे प्रियकामा cherishing my welfare, प्रियपुत्रा giving birth to a beloved son, प्रियंवदा sweetspoken, कौशल्या Kausalya, यदा यदा हि whenever, दासीवच्च like an attendant, सखी वच्च like a friend, भार्यावत् like a wife, भगिनी वच्च like a sister, मातृवच्च like a mother, उपतिष्ठति served, सत्कारार्हा fit to receive courteous treatment, तव कृते because of you, मया by me, न सत्कृता never received attention.

40002736.author: Translation
40002736.content: Sweetspoken Kausalya who always cherishes my welfare. who has given me my beloved son, who has served me like an attendant, a friend, a wife, a sister and a mother deserved courteous treatment from me, but  because of you, she never received due attention from me.

40002737.author: पदार्थः
40002737.content: मया by me, त्वयि in you, सुकृतं what favour has been done, तत् that one, अपथ्यव्यञ्जनोपेतम् mixed with unwholesome curry, भुक्तम् eaten, अन्नम् rice, आतुरमिव like a sick person, इदानीम् now, माम् me, तपति is burning me.

40002737.author: Translation
40002737.content: I have done many favours to you. Like a sick person afflicted by eating rice mixed with unwholesome curry, those acts of kindness are burning me now.

40002738.author: पदार्थः
40002738.content: रामस्य Rama's, विप्रकारम् insult, वनस्य to the forest, सम्प्रयाणं च journey, प्रेक्ष्य on seeing, भीता frightened, सुमित्रा Sumitra, कथम् how, मे in me, विश्वसिष्यति will have confidence.

40002738.author: Translation
40002738.content: In seeing the insult meted out to Rama and his journey to the forest, how will frightened  Sumitra  have confidence in me?

40002739.author: पदार्थः
40002739.content: वैदेही Sita, माम् my, पञ्चत्वम् आपन्नम् having been dead, रामम् of Rama, वनम् आश्रितम् taking refuge in the forest, अप्रियम् unpleasant, द्वयम् two events, कृपणम् in a pitiable state, श्रोष्यति will listen, बत alas.

40002739.author: Translation
40002739.content: Alas Sita will listen in a pitiable state the two unpleasant events namely my death and  Rama's exile to the foest.

40002740.author: पदार्थः
40002740.content: हिमवतः पार्श्वे on the Himalayan slopes, किन्नरेण with Kinnera, हीना forsaken by, किन्नरीव like a Kinneri, शोचन्ती lamenting, वैदेही Vaidehi, मे प्राणान् my life, क्षपयिष्यति will throw away, बत what a pity

40002740.author: Translation
40002740.content: What a pity Vaidehi, lamenting like a Kinnari forsaken by a Kinnara on the Himalayan slopes, will cause death to me.

40002741.author: पदार्थः
40002741.content: अहम् I, महावने in that wilderness, प्रवसन्तम् living, रामम् to Rama, रुदतीम् crying, मैथिलीं च and Sita, दृष्ट्वा having seen, चिरम् for a long time, जीवितुम् to survive, न आशंसे हि indeed do not hope.

40002741.author: Translation
40002741.content: With Rama living in the wilderness and Sita crying, I do not hope to survive for long, indeed.

40002742.author: पदार्थः
40002742.content: सा such you are, विधवा as a widow, सपुत्रा with your son, नूनम् certainly, राज्यं कारयिष्यसि will rule the kingdom, देवि O Devi रामे प्रव्राजिते after Rama is exiled, जीवितुम् to live, न उत्सहे हि do not desire.

40002742.author: Translation
40002742.content: O Devi you will certainly rule the kingdom as a widow along with your son. (But) I do not wish to live after Rama is exiled.

40002743.author: पदार्थः
40002743.content: रूपिणीम् beautiful, अत्यन्तम् extremely, असतीं सतीम् being an unchaste woman, त्वाम् you, नरः people, विषसंयुक्ताम् mixed with poison, मदिराम् wine, पीत्वेव having partaken, सतीम् like a chaste woman, व्यवस्यामि I have a sure belief.

40002743.author: Translation
40002743.content: Like people regarding wine mixed with poison as fine before drinking it, I had a firm belief that you were a chaste woman, but while you who look extremely beautiful you are actually not so.

40002744.author: पदार्थः
40002744.content: अनृतैः untrue, सान्त्वै: with pleasing words, माम् me, बहु greatly, सान्त्वयन्ती while you are appeasing, भाषसे स्म used to speak, लुब्धः hunter, गीतशब्देन sound of music, संरुध्य  having trapped, मृगम् इव like a deer, अवधीः killed (me).

40002744.author: Translation
40002744.content: You used to console me with so many words pleasing but untrue and you killed me like a hunter getting the deer trapped and slaughtered through the melody of music.

40002745.author: पदार्थः
40002745.content: आर्याः respectable people, पुत्रविक्रायिकम् a seller of one's own son, माम् me, सुरापम् a consumer of liquor, ब्राह्मणं यथा like a brahmin, अनार्य इति as a mean person, रथ्यासु on the highway, ध्रुवम् certainly, धिक्करिष्यन्ति will censure me.

40002745.author: Translation
40002745.content: Respectable people on the highway will certainly say 'He sold away his son' and censure me as a mean person like a brahmin consuming liquor.

40002746.author: पदार्थः
40002746.content: अहो दुःखम् what a great sorrow, अहो कृच्छ्रम् what a great calamity, यत्र where, तव your, वाचः words, क्षमे endure, पुराकृतम् formerly committed, अशुभम् इव like sin, एवं विधम् in this way, दुःखम् sorrow, प्राप्तम् has befallen.

40002746.author: Translation
40002746.content: What suffering What a calamity that I am made to put up with your words. I am subject to this suffering may be as expiation for the sin formerly committed.

40002747.author: पदार्थः
40002747.content: पापे O wretch पापेन in my folly, मया by me, अज्ञानात् through ignorance, चिरम् for a long time, अभिरक्षिता protected, त्वम् you, उद्बन्धिनी serving for hanging, रज्जु: यथा like rope  उपसम्पन्ना arrived.

40002747.author: Translation
40002747.content: O wretch I protected you in my folly for a long time through ignorance, like a rope preserved which turned out to be a noose to hang me with.

40002748.author: पदार्थः
40002748.content: त्वया सार्धम् together with you, रममाणः while sporting, त्वाम् you, मृत्युम् as death, नाभिलक्षये did not mark, बालः like a child, रहसि in a solitary place, हस्तेन with hand, कृष्णसर्पमिव like a black cobra, अस्पृशम् touched.

40002748.author: Translation
40002748.content: While sporting with you, I did not realize you were death incarnate. Like a child handling a black cobra I caressed you.

40002749.author: पदार्थः
40002749.content: महात्मा magnanimous, सः that Rama, दुरात्मना by the wickedminded, मया by me, अपितृकः without father, तम् such, माम् me, अयम् this, जीवलोकः world of living beings, नूनम् certainly, अक्रोष्ठुम् to condemn, अर्हति is entitled.

40002749.author: Translation
40002749.content: Wicked I am, I have made that magnanimous Rama fatherless. This world of living beings is certainly entitled to condemn me.

40002750.author: पदार्थः
40002750.content: यः Dasaratha, स्त्रीकृते for the sake of a woman, प्रियम् dear, पुत्रम् son, वनं प्रस्थापयिष्यति sending to the forests, कामात्मा lustful, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, भृशम् greatly, बालिशः foolish one, बत  alas.

40002750.author: Translation
40002750.content: (They will say), 'Alas how utterly foolish and lustful is king Dasaratha who is sending his beloved son to the forest for the sake of a woman'.

40002751.author: पदार्थः
40002751.content: व्रतैः च due to observing  vows, ब्रह्मचर्यैश्च by observance of vows of celibacy, गुरुभिश्च by preceptors, उपकर्शितः emaciated, भोगकाले at the time of enjoying pleasures, पुनः एव again now, महत् great, कृच्छ्रम् hardship, प्रपत्स्यते is going to undergo.

40002751.author: Translation
40002751.content: '(Rama) already emaciated by observing vows related to ritual and celibacy in compliance with the orders of the preceptors has to undergo hardships again at a time when he should enjoy pleasures (of life)'.

40002752.author: पदार्थः
40002752.content: पुत्रः (my) son, मां प्रति about me, द्वितीयम् second, वचनम् word, भाषितुम् to say, नालम् is not able, वनं व्रज go to the forest, इति in this way, उक्तः if told, सः he, बाढम् इत्येव Certainly so, वक्ष्यति will say.

40002752.author: Translation
40002752.content: My son Rama will not say a second word to me, if I tell him 'Go to the forest'.He will say, 'Certainly so'.

40002753.author: पदार्थः
40002753.content: राघवः descendant of the Raghus (Rama), वनं to the forest, गच्छ go, इति like that, चोदितः urged, मे to me, प्रतिकूलं contrary, कुर्यात् यदि if he does, तत् that, मे for me, प्रियं स्यात् will be welcome, वत्सः तु but my son, न करिष्यति will not do.

40002753.author: Translation
40002753.content: If this scion of the Raghu race (Rama) urged to go to the forest acts against my order, it will be welcome but my son will not do it.

40002754.author: पदार्थः
40002754.content: शुद्धभावः pure in thought, राघवः descendant of the Raghus (Rama), मे my, भावं तु intention, न ज्ञास्यति हि will not know,  सः he, वनं to the forest, प्रव्रज go into exile, इति thus, उक्तः said by me, बाढम् इति एव certainly so, वक्ष्यति he will say.

40002754.author: Translation
40002754.content: The descendant of the Raghus (Rama) who is pure in thought will not come to know my intention. Therefore if I tell him 'Go to the forest,' he will say, 'Certainly so'.

40002755.author: पदार्थः
40002755.content: राघवे the scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), वनं प्राप्ते reaches the forest, सर्वलोकस्य for the entire world, धिक्कृतम् contemptible, अक्षमणीयम् unpardonable, माम् me, मृत्युः death, यमक्षयम् to the abode of death, नयिष्यति will conduct.

40002755.author: Translation
40002755.content: If Rama goes to the forest, the god of death will conduct me to his abode, for condemned by the entire world, I shall not be forgiven (even by Yama).

40002756.author: पदार्थः
40002756.content: मनुजपुङ्गवे eminent among men, रामे Rama, वनं गते after he has gone to the forest, मयि when I, मृते having been dead, शेषे the remaining, मम इष्टे जने when my wellwishers, किम् what, पापम् harmful acts, प्रतिपत्स्यसे you are thinking of.

40002756.author: Translation
40002756.content: With me dead and Rama, the best among men, banished, what harmful acts are you contemplating against my wellwishers?

40002757.author: पदार्थः
40002757.content: देवी कौशल्या queen Kausalya, मां च me also, रामं च Rama also, पुत्रौ च sons Lakshmana and Satrughna, हास्यति यदि if she loses, दुःखानि grief, असहती unable to bear, मामेव me only, अनुमरिष्यति will, following me, die.

40002757.author: Translation
40002757.content: If queen Kausalya loses me, Rama, Lakshmana and Satrughna will follow me into death, unable to bear the grief.

40002758.author: पदार्थः
40002758.content: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, कौशल्यां च Kausalya, सुमित्रां च Sumitra, त्रिभिः three, पुत्रैः सह along with sons, मां च with me, नरके into hell, प्रक्षिप्य having thrown, सा त्वम् such you are, सुखिता भव be happy.

40002758.author: Translation
40002758.content: O Kaikeyi consign Kausalya, Sumitra, me and my three sons into hell and be happy.

40002759.author: पदार्थः
40002759.content: मया by me, रामेण च by Rama, त्यक्तम् abandoned, शाश्वतम् divine, गुणैः with virtues,  सत्कृतम् worshipped, अक्षोभ्यम् undisturbed, इक्ष्वाकुकुलम् Ikshvaku race, आकुलम् afflicted with grief, पालयिष्यसि will rule.

40002759.author: Translation
40002759.content: You will rule undisturbed the Ikshvaku race honoured for its divine virtues. Now abandoned by me and Rama it will be afflicted with grief.

40002760.author: पदार्थः
40002760.content: तत् this, रामप्रव्राजनम् Rama's exile, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियं भवेत् चेत् if it is to his liking, गतायुषः after cessation of my life, मे to me, भरतः Bharata, प्रेतकृत्यम् funeral rites, मा स्म कार्षीत् let him not perform.

40002760.author: Translation
40002760.content: If Rama's exile is approved by Bharata, then let him not perform my funeral rites after my death.

40002761.author: पदार्थः
40002761.content: हन्त What a calamity, मम अमित्रे O enemy of mine अनार्ये O wicked one कैकयि Kaikeyi, सकामा with desires fulfilled, भव become, पुरुषपुङ्गवे foremost of men, रामे Rama, वनंगते after he leaves for the forest, मयि when I, मृते am dead, विधवा a widow, सपुत्रा with your  son, सा such as you, इदानीम् now, राज्यं कारयिष्यसि you will rule the kingdom.

40002761.author: Translation
40002761.content: O my enemy, O wicked Kaikeyi, after Rama, the foremost of men, has left for the forest your desires will be fulfilled. And after my death, you as a widow along with your son will rule the kingdom.

40002762.author: पदार्थः
40002762.content: हन्त What a calamity, मम अमित्रे O enemy of mine अनार्ये O wicked one कैकयि Kaikeyi, सकामा with desires fulfilled, भव become, पुरुषपुङ्गवे foremost of men, रामे Rama, वनंगते after he leaves for the forest, मयि when I, मृते am dead, विधवा a widow, सपुत्रा with your  son, सा such as you, इदानीम् now, राज्यं कारयिष्यसि you will rule the kingdom.

40002762.author: Translation
40002762.content: O my enemy, O wicked Kaikeyi, after Rama, the foremost of men, has left for the forest your desires will be fulfilled. And after my death, you as a widow along with your son will rule the kingdom.

40002763.author: पदार्थः
40002763.content: त्वम् you, राजपुत्रीवादेन in the name of a princess, मम वेश्मनि in my palace, न्यवसः you lived, मे to me, लोके in the world, अतुला unparalleled, अकीर्तिः dishonour, परिभवश्च disgrace, ध्रुवः certainty, पापकृतः one who has committed sinful acts, यथा as, तथा so, सर्वभूतेषु in all living beings, अवज्ञा contempt.

40002763.author: Translation
40002763.content: You lived in my palace under the name of a princess. You have brought me, for sure, unparalleled dishonour and disgrace. Everybody will look upon me with contempt as if I have committed a sinful act.

40002764.author: पदार्थः
40002764.content: मे वत्सः my son, रामः Rama, मुहुर्मुहुः often, विभुः as prince, रथैः on chariots, गजाश्वैः च on elephants and horses, यात्वा riding, महारण्ये in the wilderness, पद्भ्याम् on foot, कथम् how, विचरिष्यति will roam.

40002764.author: Translation
40002764.content: How will my son, Rama, who used to ride on chariots, elephants and horses roam the wilderness barefoot?

40002765.author: पदार्थः
40002765.content: यस्य whose, आहारसमये at the time of taking food, कुण्डलधारिणः wearing earrings, सूदाः cooks, अहंपूर्वाः proudly, प्रशस्तम् enough, पानभोजनम् food and beverages, पचन्ति स्म used to prepare, सः he, मे सुतः my son, कषायाणि astringent, तिक्तानि pungent, कटुकानि bitter, वन्यम् आहारम् wild fruits and roots, भक्षयन् eating, कथम् how, वर्तयिष्यति नु will exist.

40002765.author: Translation
40002765.content: How will my son for whom the cooks with kundalas in their ears used to proudly prepare enough food and beverages subsist on astringent, pungent, bitter wild fruits and roots?

40002766.author: पदार्थः
40002766.content: यस्य whose, आहारसमये at the time of taking food, कुण्डलधारिणः wearing earrings, सूदाः cooks, अहंपूर्वाः proudly, प्रशस्तम् enough, पानभोजनम् food and beverages, पचन्ति स्म used to prepare, सः he, मे सुतः my son, कषायाणि astringent, तिक्तानि pungent, कटुकानि bitter, वन्यम् आहारम् wild fruits and roots, भक्षयन् eating, कथम् how, वर्तयिष्यति नु will exist.

40002766.author: Translation
40002766.content: How will my son for whom the cooks with kundalas in their ears used to proudly prepare enough food and beverages subsist on astringent, pungent, bitter wild fruits and roots?

40002767.author: पदार्थः
40002767.content: महार्हवस्त्र संवीतः भूत्वा wearing costly apparels, चिरसुखोषितः having enjoyed comforts for a long time, काषायपरिधानः wearing saffron robes, कथं वा how, भूमौ on the ground, निवत्स्यति dwell (sleep)

40002767.author: Translation
40002767.content: How will he who was habituated to wearing expensive apparels and to (royal) comforts over a long period of time live (sleep) on the ground, putting on saffron robes?

40002768.author: पदार्थः
40002768.content: रामस्य Rama's, अरण्यगमनम् departure for the forest, भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् installation, एवंविधम् in this way, एतत् this, दारुणम् dreadful, अचिन्तितम् inconceivable, वाक्यम् words, कस्य whose?

40002768.author: Translation
40002768.content: Whose are these dreadful words, this inconceivable plan of Rama's exilement and Bharata's enthronement?

40002769.author: पदार्थः
40002769.content: योषितः नाम woman means, शठाः secretly doing harm to others, सदा always, स्वार्थपराः selfseeker, धिक् अस्तु shame, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः women, न ब्रवीमि I do not say, भरतस्य Bharatha's, मातरम् एव mother alone.

40002769.author: Translation
40002769.content: A woman means one who secretly harms others. This is shameful indeed. They always seek selfish interests. I do not say this of all women, only of Bharata's mother.

40002770.author: पदार्थः
40002770.content: अनर्थभावे O malicious one, अर्थपरे O covetous one नृशंसे O cruel one मम my, अनुतापाय for tormenting, निविष्टभावे having firm intention, मन्निमित्तम् for my sake, किम् what, अप्रियम् wrong, अथवापि rather, हितानुकारिणि devoted to the welfare of others, रामे in Rama, पश्यसि are seeing?

40002770.author: Translation
40002770.content: O malicious one, O covetous one, O cruel one, O woman determined to torment me, what fault have you seen in Rama who is always devoted to the welfare of others?

40002771.author: पदार्थः
40002771.content: व्यसने in adversity, निमग्नम् plunged, रामम् Rama, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, पितरः fathers, पुत्रान् their sons, परित्यजेयुः will abandon, कृतानुरागाः affectionate, भार्याः wives, पतींश्चापि (will abandon) also husbands, कृत्स्नम् the whole, जगत् world, सर्वम् completely, कुपितं स्यात् will be inflamed.

40002771.author: Translation
40002771.content: This entire world will be inflamed to see Rama plunged in adversity. Fathers will abandon their sons. Wives, attached to their husbands, will forsake them.

40002772.author: पदार्थः
40002772.content: अहं पुनः again on my part, देवकुमाररूपम् handsome like the son of a god, अलङ्कृतम् adorned, तं सुतम् that son, आव्रजन्तम् while coming (towards me), पश्यन् while looking at, दर्शनेनापि even on his appearance, नन्दामि I rejoice, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पुनः again, युवेव like a youth, भवामि च I shall also become.

40002772.author: Translation
40002772.content: When I see my son, handsome and welladorned like the son of a celestial deity, coming towards me, I rejoice. Even his very sight makes me grow young again.

40002773.author: पदार्थः
40002773.content: सूर्येण विनाऽपि even without the Sun, वज्रधरेण by Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, अवर्षता वापि while not raining also, प्रवृत्ति: activity, भवेत् can happen, तु but, इतः from here, गच्छन्तम् while departing, रामम् Rama, समीक्ष्य having seen, कश्चित् any one, न जीवेत् will not live.  इति this one, मे चेतना is my conviction.

40002773.author: Translation
40002773.content: Nature's activity will continue even without the Sun or even if  Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, sends no rain but none will live to see Rama departing to the forest. This is my conviction.

40002774.author: पदार्थः
40002774.content: विनाशकामाम् wishing my destruction, अहिताम् wishing harm, अमित्राम् like an enemy, त्वाम् you, आत्मनः  I, मृत्युमिव like death, अवासयम् sheltered महाविषा highly posionous, सर्पी female snake, चिरम् for a long time, अङ्केन on the lap, धृतासि were carried, तेन for that reason, मोहात् with delusion, हतः अस्मि I am being ruined.

40002774.author: Translation
40002774.content: Alas I carried all along on my lap a highly poisonous female snake I gave you shelter while you were like death .This delusion is the cause of my ruin.You were my enemy. You wished me harm. You wished my destruction.

40002775.author: पदार्थः
40002775.content: भरतः Bharata, मया from me, लक्ष्मणेन च together with Lakshmana, रामेण with Rama, हीनः devoid, त्वया सह with you, बान्धवान् relatives, निहत्य after slaying, पुरं च the city, राष्ट्रं च the kingdom, प्रशास्तु he may rule, मम my, अहितानाम् of the foes, अभिहर्षिणी causing delight, भव become.

40002775.author: Translation
40002775.content: With Rama and Lakshmana withdrawn from me, my kinsmen killed, let Bharata along with you rule the city and the kingdom causing delight to my enemies.

40002776.author: पदार्थः
40002776.content: नृशंसवृत्ते cruelnatured one, व्यसनप्रहारिणि striking one while in difficulties, अद्य now, प्रसह्य् forcibly, यत् वाक्यम् which words, भाषसे you are speaking (with that), ते your, मुखात् from face, दशनाः teeth, सहस्रधा in thousand fragments, विशीर्यमाणाः broken to pieces, केन why, अधः to the ground, न नाम पतन्ति why are they not falling.

40002776.author: Translation
40002776.content: O cruelhearted woman, you strike one in adversity. Why are your teeth with which you are now speaking (such harsh words) do not fall to the ground, broken into a thousand fragments?

40002777.author: पदार्थः
40002777.content: रामः Rama, किञ्चित् even a little, अहितम् harmful, अप्रियम् unkind, वचः words, न आह does  not speak, परुषाणि harsh, भाषितुम् to speak, न वेत्ति does not know, अभिरामवादिनि one who talks pleasingly, गुणनित्यसम्मते in a man who is always honoured for his virtues, रामे in Rama, दोषान् faults, कथं नु how, ब्रवीषि are you telling?

40002777.author: Translation
40002777.content: How do you find fault with Rama who does not utter even one harmful or unpalatable word, who does not know how to use harsh words, and who speaks pleasingly and who is always honoured for his virtues?

40002778.author: पदार्थः
40002778.content: केकयराजपांसनि O obloquy on the house of Kekaya, प्रताम्य वा grieve, प्रज्वल वा or get burnt (in the fire), प्रणश्य वा or get destroyed, सहस्रशः into thousand pieces, स्पुटिता broken, महीम् the earth, व्रज वा reach, सुदारुणम् terrible, मम me, अहितम् harmful, ते your, वचः words, न करिष्यामि I will not do.

40002778.author: Translation
40002778.content: O obloquy on the house of Kekaya, you may grieve or burn yourself in the fire, or get  destroyed. Even if you fall down on earth broken into a thousand pieces I will not act on your terrible, harmful words.

40002779.author: पदार्थः
40002779.content: क्षुरोपमाम् like a knife, नित्यम् always, असत्प्रियंवदाम् speaking pleasant lies, प्रदुष्टभावाम् wickednatured lady, स्वकुलोपघातिनीम् destroyer of your own race, अमनोरमाम् one who does not impress the mind, सबन्धनम् along with all binding, हृदयम् heart, दिधक्षमाणाम् intent on burning, त्वाम् you, जीवितुम् to live, न विषहे cannot  tolerate.

40002779.author: Translation
40002779.content: You are like a knife. You always speak palatable lies. You are  malevolent. You are a destroyer of your own race. You displease the mind. You are intent on burning down all the links of my heart. I cannot bear to see you alive in this world.

40002780.author: पदार्थः
40002780.content: आत्मजेन विना without my son (Rama), मे for me, जीवितम् life, नास्ति does not exist, पुनः again, सुखम् happiness, कुतः from where, आत्मवतः of a selfrespecting man like me, रतिः pleasure, देवि O queen, मम my, अहितम् harmful act, कर्तुम् to do, न अर्हसि does not behove you, ते your, पादौ feet, स्पृशाम्यपि will touch also, मे in me, प्रसीद show favour.

40002780.author: Translation
40002780.content: There is no life for me without my son (Rama). What to speak of happiness again? Where is pleasure for a selfrespecting man like me? O queen, it does not behove you to do this harmful act. I will touch your feet. Show pity on me.

40002781.author: पदार्थः
40002781.content: अतिमात्रया exceeding the limit of respect, स्त्रिया by a woman, हृदये in the heart, गृहीतः having grasped, सः that, भूमिपालः king, अनाथवत् like an orphan, विलपन् wailing, प्रसारितौ stretched apart, देव्याः the queens, चरणौ both feet, असम्स्पृश्य (असम्प्राप्य) without touching (without reaching), आतुरः sick, यथा as, तथा so, पपात fell down.

40002781.author: Translation
40002781.content: The king, with his heart in the grip of a woman, wailing like an orphan tried to reach her feet, exceeding the limit of selfrespect but, unable to touch them as she pulled them apart, he collapsed like a sick man. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
